en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard with three photographs of stone ruins on a hillside. The images show crumbling walls, arches, and fortifications surrounded by rocky terrain and sparse vegetation. On the right side, printed text in French reads "GRÈCE – Péloponèse – MISTRA" and each photo is captioned with a small number and the word "Mistra." A faint circular stamp and a printed URL watermark (elia.org.gr) also appear.
